## Purge expired media
Ports local-agent/purge-expired-media.mjs (documented but never actually automated -- manual/cron only today) as a real daily Schedule Trigger. expired_media()/mark_media_purged() had no migration file anywhere in the repo -- backfilled in 20260922100000_backfill_undocumented_functions.sql alongside this build.

Bucket is derived from kind (photo -> contact-photos, audio -> voice-memos) because it is not stored on the row -- same mapping supabase/functions/twilio-webhook/index.ts uses.

storage_path is only cleared (mark_media_purged) for rows whose bucket delete actually succeeded -- if Delete From Storage fails for either bucket, the whole run fails and nothing is marked purged (n8n's default stop-on-error, deliberately not overridden): a stale row survives to the next run rather than orphaning bytes on a failed delete, same invariant purge-expired-media.mjs's own success-only-marks-purged logic keeps.

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 0). "Postgres (n8n pipeline)" and "Supabase Storage (n8n)" are placeholder credentials -- see n8n/README.md. This closes a real, currently-open retention gap once activated for real, independent of skill-porting sequencing.
